function mountArchScene3d(canvas, roots, onPick): Promise<ArchSceneHandle | null>

Defined in: experiments/docs/arch-scene-3d.ts:252

Mounts the scene3d arm: engine → orbit rig → async graph build → rAF loop. Returns null on ANY engine/artifact failure — the caller (mountArchScene) drops to the three.js path, so this mount can never regress the portal.

Parameters

canvas

HTMLCanvasElement

Target canvas (same element the three path uses).

roots

object[]

Manifest root buckets.

onPick

(_path) => void

Called with the manifest path on a node pick.

Returns

Promise< | ArchSceneHandle | null>

The scene handle, or null when the engine can't mount.
